veranderings.blok: Die ander kant van die speelgrond
veranderings.voor: of hy dit wil hê, en hoe
veranderings.na: of hy dit wil hê en hoe
veranderings.rede: Under the AWS rule used here, 'en hoe' is an elliptical second indirect question without its own subject and verb, so no comma goes before 'en'; the reviewer may keep the comma if it is judged a deliberate pause in the dialogue.
